stem: What is the significance of the crowd returning at lunchtime to watch Maniac?

options.label: A
options.text: It emphasizes that any attempt to untie the knot is an important event to the town.

options.label: B
options.text: It suggests that Maniac performs tasks better when he has an audience.

options.label: C
options.text: It suggests that people in town expect Maniac to have given up already.

options.label: D
options.text: It emphasizes that most people in town buy their food from Mr. Cobble's store.
